item.title: Appeals court takes up fight over wording of Missouri abortion ban ballot measure
item.description: (Missouri Independent) – A state appeals court will hear arguments Wednesday over whether Missouri Republicans erred in how they drafted a constitutional amendment banning abortion that voters will see on next year’s ballot.
